ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota's Childcare System
ideas.description: Investigate the financial transactions and funding sources of Minnesota's childcare system to identify potential fraud and abuse.
ideas.angle: Financial analysis and public records review
questions: What are the sources of funding for Minnesota's childcare system?
Are there any unusual or unexplained transactions?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial transactions and funding sources of Minnesota's childcare system, we may be able to identify potential fraud and abuse. This could involve reviewing public records and conducting financial analysis to identify unusual or unexplained transactions.
